mechanism_narrative: A rebound in WORKPLACES mobility lifts weekday trip chaining into shopping districts, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks when workplace activity recovers from its recent trough.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-4-week average over the next 28 days even as WORKPLACES rises week over week for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL mobility holds elevated while TRANSIT stays depressed, people substitute toward nearby shopping and leisure trips, pushing RETAIL_REC up within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains at least 25 points below baseline while RESIDENTIAL stays at least 15 points above baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days after the joint condition of elevated RESIDENTIAL and deeply depressed TRANSIT is observed.

mechanism_narrative: A further weekly rise in PARKS mobility acts as a leading indicator of discretionary out-of-home activity, and that spillover increases RETAIL_REC over the following week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by 5 points or more from one week to the next
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise in the next weekly mean after a week-to-week PARKS increase of at least 5 points.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT improves while WORKPLACES remain weak, the mobility rebound is transport-led rather than work-led, which still raises RETAIL_REC over a four-week horizon through easier access to commercial areas.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT moves upward by at least 3 points over two consecutive weeks while WORKPLACES stays below -15
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior four-week mean over the next 28 days after transit-led improvement occurs under weak workplace mobility.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in PARKS and RESIDENTIAL together signals fading stay-at-home and outdoor substitution behavior, which supports higher retail recreation visits over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 28 days despite simultaneous multiweek declines in PARKS and RESIDENTIAL.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM rises while WORKPLACES fall, households are concentrating essential trips and avoiding discretionary shopping, so RETAIL_REC weakens over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM is above 5 while WORKPLACES is below -20
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases within 14 days when essential-trip concentration rises and workplace mobility remains deeply negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp weekly drop in TRANSIT reduces casual access to shopping corridors, so retail and recreation mobility falls in the next week even if other categories are stable.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls by 4 points or more week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline in the next weekly mean after a week-on-week TRANSIT drop of at least 4 points.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM stays positive and RESIDENTIAL remains elevated, households are still meeting needs locally, which caps retail recreation demand and keeps RETAIL_REC below its prior four-week average over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM remains positive and RESIDENTIAL stays elevated.
